name: the art of constructing a human
source:
You wake up in a body that is not your own. You must learn the rules of this new form to escape the nightmare you’ve trapped yourself in and become human once more.

[From [url=https://sbriggs.itch.io/the-art-of-constructing-a-human]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个不属于你自己的身体中醒来。你必须学习这种新形态的规则，才能摆脱自己陷入的噩梦，再次成为人类。

[来自[url=https://sbriggs.itch.io/the-art-of-constructing-a-human]Itch.io[/url]]
